name: Bismuth Android
description: Experimental GLES 3.1 GPU draw bridge for Geometry Dash Android 2.2081.

gpu-draw-bridge-enabled.name: Enable experimental GPU draw bridge
gpu-draw-bridge-enabled.description: Routes supported atlas draw calls through a GLES 3.1 compute-generated index buffer. The current bridge keeps every quad visible; GPU culling and measurable FPS gains are not implemented or guaranteed.
